open_points.subject: A25
open_points.text: The limiter key (Normative rules above) has no witness yet
open_points.question: Is the limiter-key rule still a formal invariant, and if so what invariant identifier and exact assertion replace the removed TRN-004?
options: Restore TRN-004 with the former limiter-key assertion.
Create a new invariant identifier with an explicitly revised assertion.
Declare that the limiter-key rule is normative behaviour but not a formal invariant.
open_points.default_guess: Restore TRN-004 and give it an exact Required tests item.

open_points.subject: A25
open_points.text: together with the route and request-controlled-input cases.
open_points.question: Which route cases and which request-controlled inputs must the check exercise, and what bucket-sharing or bucket-separation result must each case demonstrate?
options: Different routes must use different buckets, while headers, cookies, query parameters and body values must not affect the key.
Test only the formerly named forwarded-header and cookie cases, plus separation by route.
Let the Factory check choose representative request inputs without fixing them in State 2.
open_points.default_guess: Specify that different routes separate buckets and that every request-controlled value other than the route is irrelevant, with concrete forwarded-header, cookie, query and body cases.

open_points.subject: A25
open_points.question: Must State 2 close by adding a verification command that runs the existing Factory check, or is this missing witness intentionally assigned to one of the declared later witness-resolution states?
options: Add and name the runnable verification command before State 2 closes.
Carry the work explicitly to decision_witness_resolution and State 8 assembly.
Remove the item from Required tests until a runnable witness exists.
open_points.default_guess: Add a runnable verification command before State 2 closes and bind the limiter invariant to it.
